Unauthenticated GET /SSO/API/AppList/allApps returned HTTP 401.
No actual authenticated event DTO was available. URL values in parser unit
tests are synthetic cases, not a captured or verified school event endpoint.
Historical investigation only: AppList/GUID discovery was removed because it
did not establish an event session. The public form is captured in
event_login.html. EventLoginService now submits Account/Password once in a
shared WebView, preserving the form token and matching HttpOnly CSRF cookie.
Public GET /MvcTeam/Act/ApplyMe redirects to the login form with ReturnUrl.
Its protected response is used to verify the session; /MvcTeam/Act is public.
GET login returns __RequestVerificationToken_L012Y1RlYW01; path=/; HttpOnly.
No live credentials or registration submissions were used in these checks.
